name: cbp-learning-workflow
description: The hub's learning-and-self-improvement workflow installed as a plugin (#187 distribution pilot, cluster 3): capture error→fix→lesson patterns from real sessions into .claude/learnings.json, distill them into skill proposals, and keep the knowledge base pruned — with the dispatch closure (learn-n-improve, skill-factory, test-knowledge, update-practices + context-reducer and session-summarizer agents) so one /plugin install gives a working learning loop.
